_doc: Stream C (play-test 5, T5): the starting equipment a new character chooses after the look screen. Per class: exactly 3 `armour` sets ({id, name, blurb, pieces: [armour base keys]}, 3 pieces each, budget bases only — cloth/light/medium/heavy helm, chest, legs, gauntlets, boots; never plate/runed/scaled/dragon gear, never heavier than the class wears) and 3-6 `weapons` packs ({id, name, blurb, main, off?, style?, element?, spell?}). `main`/`off` are item base keys (emberveil items.json weaponBases/armorBases, plus the foci Farhold's foci.js adds in memory: grimoire, seer_orb, reliquary, psalter, effigy). For a caster: `element` is the wand/staff/sceptre's element (fire, ice, lightning, poison, shadow, arcane — Farhold has no holy attunement), `spell` a staff's spell key (Farhold weapons.js STAFF_SPELLS for that element), `style` a wand's castStyle (docs/requests.md 'Round 5 contracts — C', T15). The FIRST weapons pack of a class is its old Farhold starter, so a character made with no choice gets what it got before; the first armour set contains the old starting armour. Blurbs say what the thing IS and carry no numbers. Read by js/rules/starter-kits.js (kitsFor / validKit / starterGear); checked by tests/C/starter-kits.test.mjs. This file is GENERATED from a table (the generator lived in the agent scratchpad) but is the source of truth now: edit it by hand. Owner feedback 6 (U15): no pack is strictly worse than another — every pack fills BOTH hands (a one-hander always has a shield, buckler, focus or second weapon beside it) or is a two-hander; every class with a shield has a one-hander-and-shield pack. Owner feedback 8 (W23, 'too many similar items'): 4-6 packs a class, no two of them near-duplicates (the measure is in js/rules/starter-kits.js packSignature: hands, attack family, reach band, element, tempo — two packs must differ on at least two, and no more than two packs of a class share a hand shape); every armour set has a `lean` (see `leans`). `role` and `diff` on the kit screen are WRITTEN BY CODE from the signature, never stored here.

leans._doc: Owner feedback 8 (W23): the three armour sets of a class differ in STATS, not only in weight. A set's `lean` puts these properties on its CHEST piece (kit items only; shown on the item card like any property).

guard.name: Sturdy
guard.text: Sturdier: more armour and more health.

swift.name: Nimble
swift.text: Lighter on your feet: you dodge more and act sooner.

keen.name: Fierce
keen.text: Hits harder: more damage and more critical hits.

wise.name: Deep
wise.text: A deeper well: more mana, and it comes back faster.

ward.name: Warded
ward.text: Safer: more health and resistance to magic.
